issue_context.title: Huge Breaking Issue in Net7 with MemberInfo equality
issue_context.body:
### Description

If you compare 2 Memberinfos in Net7 from a Class and a Base they are equal in 7 but not in Previous Versions.
Cause of this my Database Mapping Framework did not work any more.
see issue: https://github.com/linq2db/linq2db/issues/3823

### Reproduction Steps

Try this code in Net6 it returns false, in 7 it returns true

```csharp
    var i1 = typeof(a).GetProperty("c");
    var i2 = typeof(b).GetProperty("c");

    Console.WriteLine(i1 == i2);
    Console.ReadLine();

    class a
    {
        public string c { get; set; }
    }

    class b : a
    { }
```

### Expected behavior

Code should return false

### Actual behavior

returns tre

### Regression?

Yes

### Known Workarounds

None

### Configuration

_No response_

### Other information

_No response_
